description: FastAPI route handlers for article-related endpoints, including listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting articles.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI router instance used to define article-related API endpoints.

methods.name: list_articles
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list articles with optional filters.

methods.name: create_new_article
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new article.

methods.name: retrieve_article_by_slug
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific article by slug.

methods.name: update_article_by_slug
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing article by slug.

methods.name: delete_article_by_slug
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove an article by slug.
